items.text: Land at Tokyo Haneda (TK198). Immigration, bags, buy or top up Suica.

To the hotel: decided on arrival. Usual option: Keikyū Airport Line, through trains to the Toei Asakusa Line → Asakusa, then walk ~10 min or Ginza Line 1 stop to Tawaramachi. Taxi is the tired option.
Check in at APA (they know we arrive late). Ask reception to phone Tama Sushi (T23): closing day and a ~17:30 seat for Wed 11.
Ramen nearby if open, otherwise a konbini.
